caption: The drawing features a single figure resembling a doll or mannequin situated at the center of the page. The figure has an overall human shape with a disproportionately large torso, short legs, and arms that are curved outward. The skin of the figure is shaded light brown to suggest volume, with darker brown areas for deeper shadows and accentuated musculature. There are patch-like patterns on the shoulders, elbows, and thighs, suggesting the figure is made from stitched fabric. The facial features are stylized with arched black eyebrows, black eyes, a small red mouth, and a faint nose line, while the black hair is covered in part by a grey headband. The figure's legs are wrapped with light blue bands just above the knees, and the feet are colored yellow and brown, resembling shoes or socks. The background is plain beige, with visible brown spots and smudges scattered irregularly, giving the sheet an aged appearance. The lower right corner contains a faint inscription, possibly a signature.
title: Primitive Doll
